body:
1\. A refused phone command can expose its secret 🐞 Bug ⛨ Security 
_decide passes the typed job id through match_job_id and then publishes and logs its error
verbatim when the final token authenticates the command. If someone enters the command secret as
both the job id and the final token, the resulting no such job reason contains that secret in the
notification and daemon log.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description An authenticated phone decision can echo a mistyped job id containing the command secret into a notification and log. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/phone.py[416-444] - src/hands/api.py[174-201] ## Recommended Fix Keep untrusted typed ids out of published and logged refusal reasons, including ambiguous-id errors. Add a test that supplies the secret as both job id and final token and checks notifications and logs. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
